# Anime Manga House (动漫屋) fixtures

`series.html` contains metadata and 1,022 chapter entries from [山海逆战](https://www.dm5.com/manhua-shanhainizhan1/), captured on 2026-10-25. It preserves chapter order, paid-entry locks, both creators, and the full synopsis, including its hidden continuation and repeated punctuation.

`reader.html` contains the reader declarations for chapter `521974` and its 13-page count. Signing values are synthetic. Browser mocks use the captured response format and first image paths, controlled paths for later batches, and generated PNG images.
